lines.zh: 我摆尾，泥底浮起一层雾。
lines.en: My tail stirs a haze up from the mud.

lines.zh: 河底的石头被我一碰就动。
lines.en: A stone on the riverbed shifts when I brush it.
I rise along the edge of the waterweeds.
The current is slow; I'm slower.
My fin sweeps the sand as I turn.
A gold scale flashes in the dark water.

lines.zh: 我绕过树根，继续往上游。
lines.en: I round a root and keep heading upstream.

lines.zh: 水面上的落叶我顶了一下。
lines.en: I butt a fallen leaf on the surface.
One tailbeat and I slip into the shallows.

lines.zh: 泥里我的影子模模糊糊。
lines.en: My shadow blurs in the mud.
I ease along the riverbank.
The weeds part for me and close again.
I pass a stone gap, scales scraping rock.

lines.zh: 河底的每块石头我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone along this riverbed.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口水草，又吐出来。
lines.en: I bite a mouthful of weed and spit it out.
I swim around the eggs in the shallows.

lines.zh: 上游的凉水冲得我偏了。
lines.en: Cold water from upstream pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上撒食，我上去了。
lines.en: Someone scatters food on the bank; I go up.
I hover by the weeds, fins barely moving.
The riverbed mud is soft; I can rest here.
Light comes down through the surface in stripes.
I open my mouth and take in water.
A water bug crawls across my scales.
I stay still while a leaf covers my back.
The water keeps sounding; I'm used to it.
A snail on the sand creeps along.
I dip my barbels into the mud.
The water in this bend is a little warmer.

lines.zh: 我转身迎水，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I face the flow and work my gills.

lines.zh: 一条泥鳅从旁边钻过去。
lines.en: A loach slips past me.
Patches of broken light shift on the surface.
Staying here is steadier than upstream.

lines.zh: 岸上的影子落下来，我上浮。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the bank; I rise.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水里，很长。
lines.en: Your shadow falls long across the water.

lines.zh: 我绕着你投下的石头转。
lines.en: I circle the stone you threw in.
You crouch, and the surface comes closer.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边的浅水里停住。
lines.en: I stop in the shallows by your feet.
Your hand enters and the water shivers.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你的脸，隔着水。
lines.en: I look up at your face through the water.
You walk a few steps; I follow.
Your boots cave in the bank.

lines.zh: 人影我不躲，网一落我就慌。
lines.en: Shadows don't scare me; nets do.
Something slaps me and scales come off.
The water muddies and I dive into the weeds.
The pain makes me thrash.
Only three points of health; stop chasing.
A strip of my pectoral fin is torn.
I float belly-up for a moment.
I churn the mud until nothing shows.
I hide in a rock gap and hold my gills.
I'll carry this wound into next year.
My blood fades fast in the water.

lines.zh: 你手里的面包，我看见了。
lines.en: The bread in your hand is plain to see.
I swim toward your hand.
That smell drifts down with the current.
I open my mouth, waiting for you to drop it.
A small piece lands and I snatch it.

lines.zh: 你的饵比水草好吃多了。
lines.en: Your bait tastes far better than weeds.
I circle your palm.

lines.zh: 手别缩回去，我才吃半口。
lines.en: Don't pull back yet; I'm only half fed.
I eat so fast the water clouds.
You move, and I follow one step.

lines.zh: 你碰我，我滑得像块湿石。
lines.en: I slip from your touch like a wet stone.
I bump your leg and my scales quiver.
The water pushes me against you.
You grab, and I slip through your fingers.

lines.zh: 我的尾一甩，打在你腕上。
lines.en: My tail flicks against your wrist.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花很小。
lines.en: We collide with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子蹭过去。
lines.en: I brush past your boot.
You shift, and I flip over entirely.
I'm not hard; collisions don't hurt.
Your handprint stays on my scales.
The spring water warms and I go looking for her.
We lie side by side by the shallow weeds.
She flicks her tail and scatters eggs into the weeds.

lines.zh: 水草根下全是小小的卵。
lines.en: The weed roots are covered in tiny eggs.
I keep watch over that patch of shallows.
We circle the clump of weeds.
This bend is just right, not deep.
The eggs cling to stems, glinting.

lines.zh: 我把泥沙拨开，护住它们。
lines.en: I push the silt aside to shelter them.
When the water rises, they scatter.
What you drop settles on the mud.
I nudge that shiny flake.
My mouth is small; I can't hold it.
It rolls into a gap I can't enter.
I touch it with a barbel; it's hard.
I push it under the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 那东西不是吃的，我吐了。
lines.en: It isn't food, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我在那东西边上转了转。
lines.en: I make a couple of turns beside it.
A puff of mud hides it.

lines.zh: 我连自己的卵都护不住。
lines.en: I can't even guard my own eggs.
There's a bug on the weed; I fix on it.
That leaf is moving; it's a bug.
I swim toward that little shadow.
A morsel falls and I chase it.
I chase only small things, never big ones.
A snail turns up in the mud; I stop.

lines.zh: 水面上一圈圈乱纹，是活物。
lines.en: Rings of disturbed water mean something alive.

lines.zh: 我锁住那根晃动的草茎。
lines.en: I fix on that swaying stem.
It's only a finger's width away.
I open my mouth and water rushes in first.
I hover above that patch of weeds.
The bug still crawls; I wait for it to drop.
I aim my mouth at the leaf.

lines.zh: 水势自会把它推到我嘴边。
lines.en: The river's flow will deliver it.
The moment it pauses, I close in.
My barbel touches it first.
My shadow falls and it shrinks back.
I slowly straighten myself.
One bite away, no more.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我偏了。
lines.en: Surface glare throws off my aim.
I ram forward and hit nothing.
My mouth hits a weed stem.

lines.zh: 这点力气，连螺都推不动。
lines.en: This strength can't budge a snail.
I bite the bug and shake it twice.
My tail slaps and spray scatters.
One butt and its belly faces up.
I haven't any teeth; I just butt.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己也撞晕。
lines.en: The blow dazes me too.
The leaf snaps and the bug escapes.

lines.zh: 我这点劲，只够对付小虫。
lines.en: My strength only works on tiny bugs.
The shallows gain one more carp.

lines.zh: 水草根须间，我挤了出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out from between the weed roots.
One or two of me at a time, no more.
The egg cracks and I drop into the river.
When I was born my scales were grey.
Water from upstream washes me down.
I find soft mud in the river bend.
I'm just learning that light on the surface.
This river is wide enough; I'll stay.
Soft mud suits me well.

lines.zh: 河水烫起来，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The river heats and I dive deep.

lines.zh: 我摔在河岸上，尾巴直拍。
lines.en: On the bank, my tail slaps and slaps.

lines.zh: 我被捞出水面，鳃贴着头。
lines.en: Lifted out, my gills clamp shut.
The blast throws me onto the shallows.

lines.zh: 箭尖划开我的侧鳞，很疼。
lines.en: An arrowhead slices my flank scales open.
A force pins me in the water.

lines.zh: 水草被吃光，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: The weeds are gone and I grow faint.
Lightning hits the river and I lock up.
All the water is gone; I just fall.
